reading.reading: The temporary global note is exchangeable for the permanent global note no earlier than 40 days after the issue day. Exchange requires presentation of certificates under U.S. tax law that the beneficial owners are not U.S. persons, except certain financial institutions or certain persons holding through such institutions. Interest on notes represented by the temporary global note is paid only after such certificates are presented, with a separate certificate for each payment. A certificate received on or after the 40th day after the issue day is treated as a request to exchange under section 1(3)(b). Securities delivered in exchange may be delivered only outside the United States as defined in section 6(2).
reading.certificate_basis: U.S. tax law as referenced by this contract; substantive rules not evaluated
express_exceptions: certain persons holding through such financial institutions
reading.qualification: These are contractual prerequisites, not proof that a beneficial owner is eligible or a certificate is legally sufficient. The territory definition does not define U.S.-person status or the unspecified classes of excepted institutions/persons. No actual certificate, owner status, exchange request or delivery is supplied. Reaching day 40 does not waive certification, complete an exchange or establish interest entitlement.
